name: How to Plan Your Full Bathroom Renovation Without Major Headaches

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Planning a full bathroom renovation can feel like a huge undertaking, but breaking it down makes it much more manageable. Here's a simple process to guide you. Step 1: Set Your Vision and Budget. Before anything else, decide on your layout, what features are must-haves, and what you're willing to spend. This helps guide all subsequent decisions. Step 2: Measure and Get Quotes. Grab your tape measure and get precise dimensions of your current bathroom. Then, reach out for itemized quotes from reputable contractors. Make sure you understand what's included and excluded. Step 3: Verify the Contractor. Always check their license and insurance. Ask for references and look at their past work. This is crucial for peace of mind. Step 4: Plan the Nitty-Gritty. This is when you'll schedule demolition, rough-in work for plumbing and electrical, waterproofing, and finally, the finishes like tile and paint. Step 5: Final Inspection. Don't skip this! Make sure everything is up to code and meets your expectations. Remember, lead times for materials can be long, sometimes up to eight weeks, so plan accordingly. If you're in Berkeley or the East Bay, Frasheski Construction can help you through this whole process, from permits to the final touch.
